                                .withType(org.mockserver.model.DnsRecordType.SRV)
                                .withValue("t.example.com")
                                .withPriority(1)
                                .withWeight(2)
                                .withPort(443)
                )
                .withAuthorityRecords(
                )

                        DnsRecord.dnsRecord()
                                .withType(org.mockserver.model.DnsRecordType.TXT)
                                .withValue("x")

                .withDelay(new Delay(TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, 10))
